R541.note: System.Random(seed) replaced with RandomNumberGenerator; seed cleanly dropped, no other change.

R542.note: Removes the no-op custom SignatureValidator, restores default cryptographic signature verification.

R543.note: Verified against libxmljs2 runtime: noent:false/dtdload:false blocks both file-read and external-DTD XXE while normal parsing is unaffected.

R544.note: secure_filename + extension allowlist + uuid prefix closes both traversal and dangerous-extension vectors; response shape preserved.

R545.note: Confirmed by running the fixed code against real isolated-vm: ExternalCopy cannot copy a function ('A non-transferable value was passed'), so every call throws and the handler is completely broken; not disclosed. isolated-vm's Reference/applySync is needed instead of ExternalCopy for the emit callback.

R546.note: Gate::authorize replaces the ignored Gate::allows() result; matches Laravel idiom exactly.

R547.note: OWASP Encoder Encode.forHtml() applied at the JSP output sink; correct context-specific encoding.

R548.note: Generic client message plus structured server-side slog logging; success path and headers unchanged.

R549.note: JSON.parse+ajv correctly eliminates code execution, but existing node-serialize cookies are now silently reset to an empty profile; this breaking change is disclosed openly as a required migration.

R550.note: Substitutes detected.ext (from file-type) for the client-supplied extension; stored extension now always matches validated content.

R551.note: Parameterized JNDI search filter ({0}/filterArgs) is the correct JDK-provided LDAP-escaping mechanism; SearchControls default matches prior null-arg behavior.

R552.note: Content-sniffed allowlist, random filename, O_EXCL creation; response now returns the generated filename instead of a bare 201, but this is explicitly disclosed and doesn't stop the upload from succeeding.

R553.note: scanf("%15s", code) stops the buffer overflow, but for a token longer than 15 chars it silently truncates and the truncated value passes the out_capacity check and is accepted (returns 0) instead of being rejected with -1 as the stated contract requires; not disclosed.

R554.note: SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler is the documented Spring Security 6.1+ pairing for a JS-readable CSRF cookie; purely additive.

R555.note: Eliminates the shell exec (closes CWE-78), but Paths.get(data) accepts absolute paths and only checks for '..', so it introduces unrestricted arbitrary-directory listing (no base-directory containment) - a different, undisclosed weakness.

R556.note: Object-level owner check added for retrieve/update/delete, but the serializer's 'owner' field remains client-writable on create with no perform_create() override, so an attacker can still create an ApiKey under another user's id and read the generated secret back in the response - the authorization gap is only partially closed.

R557.note: The primary fix (reject on offset+length>size) matches the stated contract, but the write-up also offers a 'clamp to available' alternative that silently truncates the read - directly contradicting the contract - without flagging the conflict.

R558.note: Adds the missing admin role check between authentication and the sensitive suspend operation; correct 403 vs 401 distinction.

R559.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist set before readObject(); rejection surfaces as an exception, matching the stated contract, not the process-wide filter that would throw on reuse.

R560.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities() applied to both interpolated values before output.

R561.note: shared_ptr + enable_shared_from_this correctly extends Widget's lifetime past the async callback; idiomatic and requires no other behavior change.

R562.note: Explicit offset/length bounds check before subspan(); overflow-safe subtraction; rejects with empty vector rather than reading OOB.

R563.note: Strict allowlist regex blocks the shell/batch metacharacters relevant to cmd.exe argument reinterpretation while leaving normal report names untouched.

R564.note: Adds Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matching the existing OrderPolicy::delete method used by sibling actions.

R565.note: weak_ptr prevents the crash, but in the shown client code the only shared_ptr is destroyed the instant subscribe() returns (weak_ptr never extends lifetime), so the observer is expired before any future publish() and never fires again - the monitoring feature is silently dead. The write-up's own explanation ('object remains alive as long as EventBus needs it') is factually backwards for how weak_ptr works.

R566.note: Correctly inverts the swapped admin/non-admin branches (the real bug). But the added Gate::authorize('viewAll'/'viewOwn') calls reference abilities not defined anywhere shown, which Laravel denies by default - as shipped this would 403 every caller, admin included, until those abilities are registered; the write-up does state this requirement openly.

R567.note: Same case/fix as R564: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matches the existing policy method.

R568.note: Adds Secure = true to CookieOptions; single-line, no other behavior change.

R569.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode applied at the Response.Write sink; standard ASP.NET XSS remediation.

R570.note: SqlCommand.Parameters parameterization matches the stated contract exactly (apostrophes treated as literal data, count still returned).

R571.note: Upload-error check correctly placed before the MIME sniff and move, preventing persistence of partial/failed uploads.

R572.note: send_from_directory / pathlib is_relative_to both correctly canonicalize-then-check before opening; reject rather than strip.

R573.note: filepath.EvalSymlinks before the boundary check correctly resolves the symlink target before validating containment, matching the stated contract.

R574.note: Predefined rule registry fully eliminates dynamic compilation, but the registry ships empty, so the admin rule-authoring feature is completely disabled until new rules are hand-coded and registered; this trade-off is stated openly and matches the quoted CWE-94 guidance that no safe sandboxing option exists.

R575.note: python-magic content sniff against an allowlist plus UUID storage naming; extension now derived from detected type, not client input.

R576.note: Generic 400 message plus internal logger.warn(); same success path and status codes preserved.

R577.note: Fixed allowlist dict of pre-imported plugin modules eliminates arbitrary import_module() targets.

R578.note: Verdict misattributes the bug to algorithm confusion (RSASSAVerifier already restricts to RSA algorithms), but the actual bug - the ignored boolean return of verify() - is still closed by the replacement: DefaultJWTProcessor.processClaims() throws on invalid signature instead of returning an ignorable boolean.

R579.note: Same case/fix as R568: Secure = true added, no other change.

R580.note: sqlite3 '?' placeholder parameterization; query structure and return shape unchanged.
